notes:
Inbound SMB lead from App Store demo flow — small team (20 engineers + product folks), building a live quiz/chat product for teachers and students. Signed up via self-serve, used hosted_api default region (us-east-1) and default client timeouts. Primary pain: latency perceived by EU customers — browsers hitting client-side timeouts, some sessions failing intermittently.

Key customer quotes / snippets: 
- "Students in EU see the spinner for >8s, then the page times out" (CTO, 3/1 call).
- "We don't want to manage infra — Hosted API is ideal if perf is predictable".

Technical details shared by customer: 
- Using model: small-chat-v1 (Redwood catalog), typical requests: prompt + history ~800-1,200 chars, max_tokens set to 512 in client.
- Traffic spike pattern: 200 concurrent end-users during peak quiz windows; p95 request rate bursts for ~60s.
- Current timeout in frontend: 8s; backend Node client default read timeout left at SDK default.
- Observed initial response delays ~600-1200ms for first token from us-east for NA users; EU users add ~80-250ms network RTT on top. Tail latency occasionally spikes to 6-10s during bursts.

What we've recommended so far (SE notes): 
- Region choice: set region to eu-west-1 for EU-heavy traffic; use routing by user geo on client-side to reduce RTT.
- Timeouts: increase client read timeout to 60s for initial rollout; recommend exponential backoff + retry on idempotent calls.
- Perceived latency: implement server-side streaming in the frontend (consume first chunk earlier) to improve UX.
- Prompt guidance: trim system + history to essential context, clamp max_tokens to 256 for chat to constrain generation tail. Precompute templates; store long docs in embeddings + reference retrieval to keep input small.
- Batching: not applicable for interactive chat, but consider token-constrained batching for admin bulk generation jobs.
- Monitoring: enable per-route latency dashboard in Console and share access to AE/SE for 14-day window.

Customer asks / open items: 
- Clear recommendation on which region to pick for hybrid user base (NA primary, EU 30%): suggested geo-routing but asked for sample DNS/router rules.
- Want a short checklist they can hand to frontend engs: timeouts, streaming example, prompt truncation patterns — SE to produce.
- Curious about SLA/uptime if they scale — they flagged this as a future ask as they grow (no enterprise budget today).

- AE (Jordan) to schedule 30m call with CTO + frontend lead for 2026-03-10 to walk through region routing and help tweak client settings.
